finalText:
**Migrated 36 call sites across 12 files.** All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Every changed file passes `node --check`.

Two calls remain in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit. Local edits are lost on upgrade.

`cache.query` is a different object. I left it alone.

Next: ask legacy-orm upstream for `execute`, or wrap the adapter.
